title: USB C Docking Station Dual Monitor Triple Display 4K Hdmi Displaylink Dock
writeup: This USB-C docking station is made for a simple desk setup: one cable from a laptop can feed dual-monitor or triple-display use, including 4K HDMI through DisplayLink, plus a charger and USB gear. It is $99.99 new. No other store listing for this exact dock was found to compare against.
